acquisition method: The most abundant precursor ions with charges from 2+ to 7+ were selected for fragmentation with a maximum cycle time of 3 s and dynamic exclusion with a duration of 10 s.
cleavage agent: The enriched proteoglycans were then digested with trypsin
collision energy: Three separate higher-energy collision-induced dissociation (HCD) MS/MS spectra were recorded for each precursor: scan 1 at the HCD collision energy of 30%... scan 2 at the HCD energy of 40%... scan 3 at the HCD energy of 40%... MS/MS spectra were recorded for each precursor with the collision energy at 20%, 30%, and 35%.
enrichment method: A two-step SAX enrichment procedure was developed to isolate CS glycopeptides in larger quantities from human urine.
fragmentation method: Three separate higher-energy collision-induced dissociation (HCD) MS/MS spectra were recorded for each precursor
instrument: The samples were analyzed on an Orbitrap Fusion mass spectrometer
ionization type: Nanospray Flex ion source was operated in positive ionization mode at 1.8 kV.
labeling: To assess the abundance of each glycoform, spectral counts of annotated MS/MS scans from the proteomic database searches were used
